## Description

Uploading the returned report on a send-out passes it through results intake (P4-014) with the send-out already matched, and marks the send-out Reported.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** The report reaches the doctor's results inbox linked to the order.
- [ ] **AC2.** A report uploaded to the wrong send-out can be moved, with the move audited.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
